SAXES 6.0.0 browser bundle

Source: https://github.com/lddubeau/saxes/tree/v6.0.0
Package integrity source: npm saxes@6.0.0
Bundled with esbuild for the browser. The XML 1.1 restricted-character range in xmlchars uses the explicit hex escape \x08 for the backspace endpoint. Published bundle SHA-256:
e157324e0ca701a47db92fdb1065ccaf06963049eb026c9e0ded513861c9f4fb

Saxes is ISC-licensed. Its required license text is in
LICENSE-ISC-saxes-6.0.0.txt. The bundled xmlchars 2.2.0 dependency is
MIT-licensed; its license is in LICENSE-MIT-xmlchars-2.2.0.txt.
